about: Mobs whose loot a hotfix changed. What was recorded of them before "since" is left out of the shared database: tools/build_data.py, tools/import_eglink.py and tools/import_everloot.py read this file. "since" is the day after the hotfix, as the hotfix notes don't give the hour.

7023.name: Obsidian Sentinel
7023.why: WoW: Forever hotfixes of November 23, 2026, Uldaman: "The Obsidian Sentinel drops loot as intended." https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24315281
